acceptance.evidence: Coal/Ember UI contract: 49 screenshots at 7 target viewports with 0 overflow and 0 page errors; Ctrl+K palette with focus restore; Ctrl+1/2/3 (not while typing); composer 98–240px; persisted keyboard-resizable panes; 200% zoom clean; reduced motion; 0 unnamed controls; controls ≥40px. Real UI journey on live routes. Gaps: no screen-reader or real-touch test (docs/qa/after/README.md).

Automated benchmark, 3 runs each, same input/provider(codex)/criterion: native CLI 8.38/9.01/9.18s, Studio 8.55/9.79/14.8s, all correct; only Studio persisted the result. Step counts (6 vs 4) and app switches (2 vs 0) are a scripted model, not observed. Owner usability benefit is UNVERIFIED: no owner trial.

Four review rounds. (1-3) An independent Claude reviewer session. (4) A paid cross-family review: gpt-6-astra via the Codex API, $2.02, four lenses (stability, security, frontend, visual with real screenshots). Each of its 68 findings was then checked by 3 independent refute-by-default verifier agents (208 agents): 54 confirmed, 14 refuted. All 54 confirmed findings were fixed with regression tests (tests/test_supervision.py, tests/test_hardening.py), except security-01 (OS-level sandboxing; mitigated by honest scope text plus a per-project agent acknowledgement). No PR/merge: local repo.
